What counts as a speakeasy?
  • An entrance deliberately hidden or disguised inside another business
  • A genuine operating connection to the Prohibition era
  • An official concept built around a secret room or concealed experience
A good cocktail list, low lighting or vintage décor alone does not qualify a regular bar or pub.
